page.overview:
Who is Eryn Loathroot?

was a teenaged dwarf living on a farmstead in the settlement of Desperloch with her father Garrick. As an NPC, she was played by Matthew Mercer.

Eryn was a dwarven teenage girl with curly dirty-blonde hair who wore a leather breastplate and a tattered cloak.

When she was corrupted by the Umbra, her eyes turned pale, her skin green, and she sprouted tentacles covered in fingers as her mouth developed red tethers and pincers. The transformation reverted for the most part after the monster was defeated, but even her original body retained some marks of the corruption, particularly around the mouth.

She was cheerful and youthfully arrogant, behaving recklessly when it favored her own ambitions, but was loved and appreciated by her neighbors nonetheless.
